title: Allow per-setup trunnion pivot position and work-datum mode on SetupDef

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Allow a setup to override the trunnion `A` pivot position in machine coordinates (MCS) and declare its work-datum reference mode so an operator can mount the trunnion at different table locations without editing the `.mch` file.

### Context
- On `#1958` (2026-11-19), the machine owner reported that an AC trunnion mounts at different positions on the mill table across jobs, so its `A` pivot location in MCS must be configurable in the setup rather than fixed in one `.mch` file.
- `#1962` stores `A.pivot` only in `.mch`, and `#1970` adds `.mch` trunnion editing plus setup `wcs_offset` (part WCS relative to `C` platter).
- In `crates/post/src/kinematics/math.rs` (lines 265-268), `P_mach = a_pivot + R_A(phi_a) * (c_offset + R_C(phi_c) * (tip + wcs_offset))` and `xyz_G54 = P_mach - work_datum`. Moving the trunnion on the table changes `a_pivot`, which affects linear stroke checks (`#1969`), table collision sweeps (`#1973`), and `G54` coordinates when `work_datum` is fixed on the table.
- `SetupDef::nose_to_axis` (`crates/app/src/schema.rs` lines 322-345, `crates/app/src/rotary_stack.rs`) sets the precedent for a setup-level override of a machine rotary figure.

### Requirements
- Add optional `trunnion_pivot: Option<[f64; 3]>` (MCS mm) and an explicit work-datum reference mode (`C` platter center at `A = 0, C = 0`, `A` pivot, part WCS at `A = 0, C = 0`, or explicit MCS `G54` vector) to `SetupDef` in `crates/app/src/schema.rs`.
- Add undoable command(s), MCP tool(s) (per AGENTS.md "Commands ship with an MCP tool"), and project file serialization (with `PROJECT_VERSION` bump if breaking).
- Expose the setup trunnion pivot and work-datum mode controls in the Setup UI alongside `#1970`'s WCS-to-pivot offset.
- Resolve effective `a_pivot` as `setup.trunnion_pivot.or(machine_a.pivot)` and stream effective `a_pivot`, `wcs_offset`, and `work_datum` into `.cnc` `PARAM`s for both `machine::check_ops` (`#1969`) and `post::engine`.
- Refuse non-RTCP multi-axis posting by name when neither the setup nor the `.mch` file states a valid finite `A` pivot.

Done means: Users can set or clear a per-setup trunnion `A` pivot position and work-datum reference in GUI and MCP, undo/redo and save/reload it, stream it to the post and machine checker, and get a named refusal when non-RTCP 5-axis posting lacks a stated pivot.

Part of #1958
